newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SIMAC PRIVATE PLACEMENT OF 150,000 SHARES.
newsitem.headline: SIMAC PRIVATE PLACEMENT OF 150,000 SHARES.

text.p: Simac Techniek said on Tuesday it would privately place 150,000 new ordinary shares.
It added that shareholder Simal Beheer BV had also sold 150,000 of its Simac shares and had granted a subordinated loan of 10 million guilders to Simac.
The issue represents about 8.6 percent of the ordinary and listed share capital of Simac and it plans to finance organic growth of the company, Simac said.
Simac repeated it expected a 1997 turnover of at least 400 million guilders. In 1996 turnover totalled 297.4 million guilders.
